frozen.hold_out_note: July 2024 onwards was already examined before these repairs: for any new change it is historical diagnostic evidence, not an untouched hold-out. Only data after an experiment's freeze time is prospective.

2000_core0.hold_out_note: July 2024 onwards was already examined before these repairs: for any new change it is historical diagnostic evidence, not an untouched hold-out. Only data after an experiment's freeze time is prospective.
reasons: (a) investable walk-forward selection AND the frozen choice's later window must both beat VAS (CAGR strictly greater, zero-rate Sharpe at least VAS's)
(c) deflated Sharpe ratio (full frozen series; trial variance from the selection window) must be at least 0.95
(d) probability of backtest overfitting (CSCV on the selection window) must be at most 0.25
(e) month-end max drawdown must be within 5 points of VAS's
(f) annual cost drag (brokerage + slippage) must be at most 1.0%
(g) at least 2 of 3 registered neighbours must pass the full criterion (a)
(h) annual excess must be positive with a 90% block-bootstrap CI lower bound above -1%
